mechanism_narrative: The FEDFUNDS rate has an inverse relationship with S&P 500 returns: lower rates predict higher returns due to reduced discount rates and increased liquidity in the financial system.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 2.5% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to inflation-driven monetary tightening and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising CPIAUCSL and falling INDPRO predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days due to stagflationary pressures reducing corporate earnings and risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising), rising CPIAUCSL predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to accelerated rate hikes and reduced equity multiples.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 5.5% predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days due to heightened recession fears and reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 800 thousand units predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days due to housing market weakness signaling potential monetary policy easing and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 800.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising HOUST and rising RSAFS predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to strong consumer demand and business investment supporting economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 95 indicates slowing economic activity, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days due to reduced manufacturing output and potential recessionary signals.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.
